subject: *: Enable plan cache for partitioned tables (#49161)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff for executor/planner/parser/table changes enabling prepared plan cache with partitioned tables. Main risk areas (partition pruning mode gating, cached-plan safety, PointGet/BatchPointGet partition routing, explicit PARTITION() semantics, DDL/add/drop partition edge cases, and session/runtime interactions) are guarded by: only allowing plan cache with dynamic partition pruning enabled, explicitly skipping plan cache when static partition processor is used, and performing runtime partition pruning for PointGet (and value/partition filtering for BatchPointGet where applicable). Checked later history up to upstream/master; subsequent follow-ups exist in the same area, and there is no remaining unfixed Blocker/High issue attributable to this commit.
